title: Spectral Echo
description: The translucent image of a long-dead warrior flickers in and out of existence at a crossroads of crumbling stone corridors. Its mouth moves soundlessly, one gauntleted hand gesturing down a passage choked with shadow. Whether it means to warn or to lure, the spirit seems bound to this place, repeating its final moments for eternity.

choices.label: Follow the echo
choices.description: The dead sometimes guard forgotten treasure.

outcomes.text: The warrior's ghost leads you through a maze of corridors to a collapsed alcove. Behind the rubble, a strongbox gleams with old gold.
The echo leads you to a hidden cache — the warrior's own burial hoard, undisturbed for centuries.
It was a lure. The passage ends in a pit trap, and spectral claws rake your party from the walls as you scramble to escape.

choices.label: Capture the spectral thread
choices.description: A quick hand can snare the ectoplasmic strands that trail behind it.

outcomes.text: You lunge and grab a fistful of ectoplasm as the echo drifts past. It shrieks silently and dissolves, leaving the precious threads in your hand.
You snare a thick strand, but the echo recoils violently. A pulse of necrotic cold burns through your arm.
The echo flickers and you grab only air. A chill settles over your party as the spirit fades, leaving nothing behind.

choices.label: Ignore the apparition
choices.description: Spectral echoes are unreliable guides at best.

outcomes.text: You avert your gaze and take a different passage. The echo continues its silent pantomime behind you, indifferent to your departure.
